# PublishRank SEO for WordPress
> PublishRank SEO 2.26.1 is a free, open-source WordPress SEO plugin for businesses, stores, service providers, creators, publishers and websites of every kind. It includes site metadata, connected schema, XML and News sitemaps, Local SEO, WooCommerce SEO, redirects, 404 monitoring, analytics, Traffic Guard, Access Shield, Schema Studio, SEO Inspector and optional editorial workflows. Version 2.26.1 unifies the Gutenberg SEO sidebar and improves media migrations, 404 diagnosis, bulk SEO review and video sitemap discovery. The supplied report records sandbox testing on WordPress 7.1.5, PHP 8.3 and SQLite and lists its limitations; it is not production-host testing. SEO metadata and structured data do not guarantee rankings or rich results.
